BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: External Credential metadata files are typically stored in source repositories that can be accessed remotely.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: Plain text credential values can be read directly once the metadata file is accessible.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: Exploitation requires access to the source repository, build artifact, or metadata files.

BASE.name: USER_INTERACTION
BASE.justification: No user interaction is required to read exposed static credential values.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: Exposed credentials can be used to affect external services or integrations outside the vulnerable source repository.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: The rule exposes sensitive values such as API keys, client IDs, and authentication tokens in plain text.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: Compromised credentials may allow unauthorized modification of connected systems or external integrations.

BASE.name: AVAILABILITY
BASE.justification: Compromised credentials may be used to disrupt external services, integrations, or authenticated resources.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: No complex exploit is required; exposed credential values can be directly reused if valid.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: Clear remediation exists by replacing static string literals with dynamic merge field references or secure credential storage.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is deterministically identified by detecting static parameterValue literals in ExternalCredential metadata files.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_ATTACK_VECTOR
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Repository or metadata access is commonly performed over a network.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: No special runtime condition is needed once the file is accessible.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Access to the repository, source artifact, or metadata file is required.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_USER_INTERACTION
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: No interaction from another user is required.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_SCOPE
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: The exposed credentials can impact systems beyond the source repository or Salesforce metadata file.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_CONFIDENTIALITY
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Plain text secrets create a high risk of credential disclosure.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_INTEGRITY
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Compromised credentials may permit unauthorized changes in connected services.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: MODIFIED_AVAILABILITY
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Credential misuse may allow disruption or denial of access to dependent services.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: CONFIDENTIALITY_REQUIREMENT
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Protecting credentials and authentication tokens is highly important.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: INTEGRITY_REQUIREMENT
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Credentials can grant write or administrative access to connected systems.

ENVIRONMENTAL.name: AVAILABILITY_REQUIREMENT
ENVIRONMENTAL.justification: Availability impact is possible through service disruption, but the primary risk is credential disclosure and misuse.
